people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”
translations.bsb: And Joseph made the sons of Israel take an oath and said, “God will surely attend to you, and then you must carry my bones up from this place.”
translations.kjv: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
translations.asv: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
